candidate_windows.window_text: All experiments fine-tune the Llama-3.1-8B-Base (Grattafiori et al., 2024) checkpoint with low-rank adaptation (LoRA) (Hu et al., 2022). For LoRA, we set the rank to 8,the scaling factor $\alpha$ to 16, and apply a dropout rate of O.O5. The learning-rate schedule is cosine decay from an initial value of $1 \times 1 0 ^ { - 4 }$ . Training employs a micro-batch size of 4,an effective batch size of 32,a sequence cutoff length of 1O24 tokens,and runs for three epochs. All generation and evaluation are performed with vLLM (Kwon et al., 2023),using a maximum model length of 2048 tokens, top $\mathbf { \nabla } \cdot \mathbf { k }$ sampling with ${ \mathrm { k } } = 1 0$ ,a temperature of O.2,and a generation limit of 500 tokens. Instruction-corpus experiments are trained on $8 \times$ NVIDIA RTX 3090 (24 GB each), whereas raw-document experiments are trained on $8 \times \mathrm { R T X 4 0 9 0 }$ (24 GB each).
